position: Additional Areas for Reform (The Importance of Space)
proposal: The Mandate recommends that the IC and DOD explore better integration of their space assets, examine joint programs and fully use Title 10 and Title 50 authorities jointly for space defense and offense strategies. It also says the IC should support alliances with like-minded partners beyond the Five Eyes, and should refocus space intelligence collection to break down barriers with DOD and embrace commercially derived capabilities, while protecting supply chains and cybersecurity.

status_summary: Executive Order 14369 (signed 2025-12-18) calls for a national security space architecture that integrates commercial space capabilities and for stronger ally and partner contributions to space security, and names the DNI as a coordinating party for a defense capability gap report, a space security strategy, an architecture plan and a State-led ally and partner plan; it does not mention the NRO, the intelligence community or joint DOD-IC programs. The Space Force and NRO continue joint work on space-based ground moving target indication, with enabling satellites launched and dedicated satellites expected from 2028 (reported 2025-08-05). The FY2026 budget request proposed removing funding for the NRO's commercial radar program and significantly reducing its commercial electro-optical layer, which runs counter to the commercial emphasis; the House intelligence committee passed a bill on 2025-09-10 that would restore the commercial imagery funds, and the final FY2026 outcome, which is classified, was not found.

timeline.event: Six commercial remote-sensing firms wrote to the leaders of the appropriations, armed services and intelligence committees asking them to reverse FY2026 request cuts that would remove commercial radar funding and significantly reduce the NRO's commercial electro-optical layer.

A Space Force general described joint Space Force and NRO work on space-based ground moving target indication; a spokesperson clarified that the satellites launched so far are enablers and dedicated GMTI satellites are expected from 2028.
The House intelligence committee passed its FY2026 authorization bill, which would restore the White House cut to NRO commercial imagery funding.

Executive Order 14369 (Ensuring American Space Superiority) was signed, calling for integration of commercial space capabilities, stronger ally and partner contributions, and DNI input to space security plans (published in the Federal Register 2025-12-23).

title: Integrate IC and DOD space assets, widen allies and embrace commercial space
uncertainties: The final FY2026 appropriation for NRO commercial imagery is a classified line and was not found; the stage may be too low or too high depending on that outcome. The June 2025 Breaking Defense article shows no publication date; its date is the date of the letter it describes. The GMTI program began before 2025, so the 2025 report shows continuation, not a new IC-DOD integration decision. The executive order's 180-day plans were due about mid-June 2026 and their outputs were not found. The August 2025 commercial space executive order (EO 14335) concerns licensing and the Office of Space Commerce and is covered in c21-06. The Space Force offensive and counterspace posture is in c04-20, which also cites EO 14369.
